newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK SOFTER ON MOST UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK SOFTER ON MOST UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed the week marginally firmer on South Africa's rand but was quoted easier against other major currencies, dealers said.
"The Zimbabwe dollar continued depreciating during the day," a dealer said.
"There wasn't any big payment that I know of....people were just protecting their positions," he said.
"Even the few times (in the last week) that the market might have been long, the rates didn't move because people have been holding back what little they have," he added.

The Zimbabwe dollar finished the day at 11.1150/1250 against the U.S. dollar down from 11.1025/1125 on Thursday and tumbled to 18.0100/0300 from 17.8775/9055 against sterling, tracking a weaker U.S. dollar on the British unit overseas.
It was also quoted easier on the mark at 6.6000/6200 compared to 6.5955/6050 but crept up on the rand to 2.4700/4900 from 2.4770/4810.
